summary: Endpoints 49-52 and 55 served via createDevRuntime, createDevRoutes and withDevComposition; review round 1 applied (injected clock, 16 KiB limits, lowercase ids, real-runtime tests).

produces.name: createDevRuntime
produces.note: createDevRuntime(deps: DevRuntimeDeps) -> { now, resolvers, upload, summaries, standup, mine, leadList }; overrides: Partial<{ gateway, sessions, ai, recordCacheHit }>; also exports DevRuntime, DevRuntimeDeps and DevError from @agile/dev

produces.name: createDevRoutes
produces.note: createDevRoutes(services: DevRouteServices): RouteDefinition[]; optional now() drives 52's default date; 50 and 51 limited to 16 KiB; ids lowercased

produces.name: createDevComposition
produces.note: createDevComposition(auth): { resolvers, routes }; uncached, registers process-wide sources once per auth runtime

produces.name: getDevComposition
produces.note: getDevComposition(auth: AuthRuntime), cached per auth in a WeakMap

produces.name: withDevComposition
produces.note: withDevComposition(core: CoreComposition, dev): CoreComposition; chains with Object.hasOwn

next: T10: build createApiApp(createAppDependencies(rt, composition), composition.routes) with composition = withDevComposition(createCoreComposition(rt), createDevComposition(rt)), rt.db = createDbClient(base), after resetContextRegistries(). Runtime overrides: gateway, sessions, ai, recordCacheHit; deps also take now.

deviations.what: Endpoint 52 validates date shape and calendar only, not the accepted-date window.
deviations.why: The task gives dateString as the only rule and the window would block reading older standups.
